boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-additional-cost ways for eligible UMBC community members to move, play, or meet at the Retriever Activities Center using a valid Black & Gold ID.

cards.title: Set up a casual court game
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center
cards.notes: Bring a few friends and check the RAC schedule before using the multipurpose courts for a casual basketball, volleyball, badminton, or soccer session.
cards.short_summary: A flexible indoor court option for an informal group game.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC identifies the RAC Courts as multipurpose courts for open recreation and says students, faculty, and staff may use recreation facilities free with a valid Black & Gold ID.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Recreation and Physical Education – UMBC
cards.access_notes: For current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; verify court availability around classes, practices, and events.

cards.title: Walk laps on the arena track
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center
cards.notes: Meet a walking partner at the indoor arena track, then use open-recreation time for an easy conversation-paced lap session.
cards.short_summary: An indoor walking hang that does not depend on the weather.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC states that the RAC Arena Track is used for open recreation and that students, faculty, and staff may use recreation facilities free with a valid Black & Gold ID.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Recreation and Physical Education – UMBC
cards.access_notes: For current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; confirm open-recreation availability before heading over.

cards.entity_name: Indoor Aquatics Facility Open Recreation Swim
cards.title: Plan an open-recreation swim
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center
cards.notes: Coordinate with friends for an indoor pool visit and follow posted recreation-swim rules, including required pool-deck footwear noted by UMBC.
cards.short_summary: A year-round indoor swim option when recreation-swim time is available.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC says its indoor aquatics facility is used for open recreation swim and that students, faculty, and staff may use recreation facilities free with a valid Black & Gold ID.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Recreation and Physical Education – UMBC
cards.access_notes: For current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; check the aquatics schedule and recreation-swim requirements first.

cards.title: Do a side-by-side cardio session
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center
cards.notes: Pick adjacent machines in the RAC Cardio Zone and set a comfortable shared workout length; treadmills, bikes, rowers, and ellipticals are listed.
cards.short_summary: A low-planning workout hang with several machine choices.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC lists cardio equipment in the RAC Cardio Zone and states that students, faculty, and staff may use recreation facilities free with a valid Black & Gold ID.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Recreation and Physical Education – UMBC
cards.access_notes: For current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; use equipment according to RAC rules and availability.

cards.title: Catch up while using the cardio balcony
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center
cards.notes: Use the main-level cardio balcony during open recreation for a paired workout overlooking the RAC gymnasium floor.
cards.short_summary: A social cardio option with a view into the gymnasium.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC says the RAC Cardio Balcony is used for open recreation and that students, faculty, and staff may use recreation facilities free with a valid Black & Gold ID.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Recreation and Physical Education – UMBC
cards.access_notes: For current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; check for schedule changes or class use.

cards.title: Train together in Weight Room 060
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center
cards.notes: Pair up for a strength session in the RAC’s free-weight-focused room, choosing movements and loads appropriate to each participant’s experience.
cards.short_summary: An open-recreation weight-room session for strength-training partners.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC says Weight Room 060 is used for open recreation and that students, faculty, and staff may use recreation facilities free with a valid Black & Gold ID.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Recreation and Physical Education – UMBC
cards.access_notes: For current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; follow RAC equipment rules and yield to scheduled use.

cards.title: Try a machine-based workout together
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center
cards.notes: Use the RAC’s machine-oriented Weight Room 063 for a shared endurance-focused or beginner-friendly strength routine during open recreation.
cards.short_summary: A machine-based option for a paced, shared workout.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC says Weight Room 063 is used for open recreation and that students, faculty, and staff may use recreation facilities free with a valid Black & Gold ID.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Recreation and Physical Education – UMBC
cards.access_notes: For current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; check equipment availability and posted room guidance.

cards.title: Build a short circuit in the fitness room
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center
cards.notes: Choose a few functional-fitness stations with friends—such as kettlebells, medicine balls, ropes, or sleds—and leave time to reset equipment.
cards.short_summary: A varied equipment space for a self-guided small-group circuit.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC lists the Functional Fitness Room’s exercise equipment and states that students, faculty, and staff may use recreation facilities free with a valid Black & Gold ID.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Recreation and Physical Education – UMBC
cards.access_notes: For current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; select activities suitable for the space and follow posted rules.

cards.title: Use the multipurpose room for open recreation
cards.subtitle: Retriever Activities Center
cards.notes: Check whether the first-floor multipurpose room is open, then use the shared indoor space for an easy, low-equipment group activity.
cards.short_summary: A reservable-feeling indoor option when it is in open-recreation use.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC states that the first-floor RAC Multi-Purpose Room is available for open recreation and that students, faculty, and staff may use recreation facilities free with a valid Black & Gold ID.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Recreation and Physical Education – UMBC
cards.access_notes: For current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; availability varies because the room also hosts classes and events.

cards.title: Look through a CADVC exhibition
cards.subtitle: Center for Art, Design, and Visual Culture, Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Visit the CADVC gallery with a friend and give yourselves time to compare observations; check its visitor information for the current exhibition and gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: A free public gallery visit in UMBC’s Fine Arts Building.
cards.evidence_claim: CADVC states that its exhibitions and events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: absolute alternatives, the 2026 Arts+ UMBC Faculty Exhibition – CADVC
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; consult CADVC visitor information for current exhibition dates, hours, directions, and parking details.

warnings: RAC access is free for current UMBC students, faculty, and staff with a valid Black & Gold ID; it is not represented here as public access.
